name: Scorpashi Venom
summary: Scorpashi venom is a reagent taken from the scorpions roaming Desolace. Kreldig Ungor needs it for a list of materials requested by Reclaimers Inc.

sections.title: A Mage’s List
sections.body: Kreldig Ungor is gathering materials in Desolace for Reclaimers Inc., following a list prepared by Leftwitch. Scorpashi venom is one of the items the mage requires, alongside hide from aged kodos. Kreldig is eager to finish the list and return to Ironforge.

faq.q: What is Scorpashi venom used for?
faq.answer: Leftwitch requires Scorpashi venom for a list of materials gathered by Kreldig Ungor for Reclaimers Inc.
Kreldig Ungor is collecting the venom in Desolace for Reclaimers Inc., following Leftwitch’s list.

faq.q: Where does Scorpashi venom come from?
faq.answer: Scorpashi venom comes from the scorpions found throughout Desolace.

faq.q: What other material is on Leftwitch’s list?
faq.answer: Kreldig also needs hides from aged kodos; Leftwitch’s directions specify aged kodos rather than dying or ancient ones.

angles.text: Leftwitch’s list calls for Scorpashi venom, one of the stranger reagents a mage may seek.
